text: Discipline Positioning:Business Administration belongs to the category of management. It is a comprehensive major that takes the operation and management activities of enterprises as its research object and integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as economics, law, psychology, and sociology. The duration of study is usually four years, and a Bachelor of Management degree is awarded upon completion. This major aims to cultivate compound talents with systematic management theory and practical ability, to meet the management needs of modern enterprises and organizations.Core features:Emphasizing the integration of theory and practice, we not only study the basic theories of management but also enhance practical operation skills through case analysis, enterprise research, simulation operation and other methods.Covering the entire enterprise process management (strategy, marketing, human resources, finance, etc.), it cultivates global thinking and cross-departmental collaboration capabilities.
